name_questions.user: Who invited the guy in the yellow shirt, {name}?
name_questions.answer: No idea. He brought good cheese though.

name_questions.user: Honestly, {name}, how do we own this many mugs?
name_questions.answer: You buy one every time we travel.

name_questions.user: {name}, how many people actually said yes to Saturday?
name_questions.answer: Fourteen, plus whoever your cousin drags along.

name_questions.user: If I drill here, {name}, will I hit a pipe?
name_questions.answer: Possibly. Let me get the detector.

name_questions.user: Um {name}, did you turn the sprinkler off at the tap?
name_questions.answer: I thought you did.

name_questions.user: Is this paint dry enough for another coat, {name}?
name_questions.answer: Give it till tonight.

name_questions.user: You did remember to close the greenhouse, didn't you, {name}?
name_questions.answer: Mostly closed. Ish.

name_questions.user: Do we still need the bubble wrap, or can it go, {name}?
name_questions.answer: Keep it. The mirror's not wrapped.

name_questions.user: {name}, want to help me move the compost bin before lunch?
name_questions.answer: Can it be after lunch?

name_questions.user: Any chance you saw where I left my sunglasses, {name}?
name_questions.answer: On your head. Like always.

name_questions.user: He's crying again. {name}, did he finish his bottle?
name_questions.answer: Most of it. He might need burping.

name_questions.user: So {name}, are we keeping the old futon or dumping it?
name_questions.answer: Dumping it. It's held together by hope.

name_questions.user: Did you zip the tent all the way up, {name}?
name_questions.answer: Yes. Mostly. Let me check.

name_questions.user: Is the punch the one with alcohol or the kids' one, {name}?
name_questions.answer: Red's for adults. Orange is safe.

name_questions.user: Can you find us something to listen to, {name}?
name_questions.answer: Podcast or that awful playlist of yours?

name_questions.user: Hey {name}, is your aunt still allergic to walnuts?
name_questions.answer: Deathly. Hide the brownies.

name_questions.user: Did the caterers say they'd bring plates, {name}?
name_questions.answer: Plates yes, cutlery no.

name_questions.user: {name}, any idea where the bottle opener went?
name_questions.answer: Your uncle's got it in his pocket.

name_questions.user: {name}, do you remember which glue works on felt?
name_questions.answer: The fabric one, in the blue tube.

name_questions.user: That's the third needle I've broken today, {name}.
name_questions.answer: Try the thicker ones, they're in the tin.

name_questions.user: {name}, the van people want to know if there's parking out front.
name_questions.answer: Tell them two spaces, by the bins.

name_questions.user: {name}, does this shade of green look too minty for the chair?
name_questions.answer: It's very toothpaste, honestly.

name_questions.user: The doorbell went again. {name}, can you let them in?
name_questions.answer: On it. Probably the Hendersons.

name_questions.user: These roses look sad. {name}, when did you last feed them?
name_questions.answer: Never, I thought that was your job.

name_questions.user: Has she had her bath already, {name}?
name_questions.answer: Yes, and she splashed me head to toe.

name_questions.user: Okay {name}, who's on nappy duty this round?
name_questions.answer: You. I did the last two.

name_questions.user: Can you, um, {name}, tape up the box with the plates?
name_questions.answer: Already did. Double tape, too.

name_questions.user: This screw keeps spinning. {name}, have we got any wall plugs?
name_questions.answer: Top drawer of the toolbox, the red ones.

name_questions.user: It's getting dark fast, {name}, where did you put the head torches?
name_questions.answer: Side pocket of the green rucksack.

name_questions.user: My legs are dead. {name}, fancy swapping drivers at the next stop?
name_questions.answer: Yeah, go on, I'm wide awake.

name_questions.user: {name}, would you mind holding the ladder steady?
name_questions.answer: Only if you promise not to wobble.

name_questions.user: What was the name of his bear again, {name}?
name_questions.answer: Mister Buttons. Don't get it wrong.

name_questions.user: How many beads do we need for one bracelet, {name}?
name_questions.answer: About thirty, if they're the small ones.

name_questions.user: {name}, are the kids still asleep behind us?
name_questions.answer: Snoring like little tractors.

name_questions.user: {name}, can you light the candles on the cake when I nod?
name_questions.answer: Got it. Do I start the singing too?

name_questions.user: Should the sofa go under the window or against the wall, {name}?
name_questions.answer: Window. We tried the wall already.

name_questions.user: Did you set out enough chairs for the grandparents, {name}?
name_questions.answer: Six, all with cushions.

name_questions.user: It's meant to freeze tonight, should we cover the seedlings, {name}?
name_questions.answer: Yes, use the old sheets.

name_questions.user: {name}, who's got the toll card?
name_questions.answer: Glovebox, under the sunglasses.

name_questions.user: The music's a bit much, {name}, could you turn it down for the neighbours?
name_questions.answer: Fine, but only a notch.

name_questions.user: Where on earth did the bed bolts end up, {name}?
name_questions.answer: In a sandwich bag, taped to the frame.

name_questions.user: Pass me the spirit level, {name}.
name_questions.answer: Here. Don't drop it this time.

name_questions.user: Are we nearly there, or is that a silly question, {name}?
name_questions.answer: Very silly. Two more hours.

name_questions.user: Last load, I promise. {name}, is the van door locked?
name_questions.answer: Locked and checked twice.

name_questions.user: This lake is freezing, {name}, are you really going in?
name_questions.answer: Watch me. Then call an ambulance.

name_questions.user: {name}, is the little one allowed juice after dinner?
name_questions.answer: Just water, her dad was very clear.

name_questions.user: Oh {name}, what time did their mum say bedtime was?
name_questions.answer: Half seven, but they'll beg for eight.

name_questions.user: Okay, this is lopsided. {name}, does it look wonky to you?
name_questions.answer: Only if you look at it.

name_questions.user: Could you grab the hose reel from the side of the house, {name}?
name_questions.answer: Sure, if it's not tangled again.

name_questions.user: Do we turn left at the roundabout or go straight, {name}?
name_questions.answer: Second exit. Then follow the signs.

name_questions.user: Before everyone gets here, {name}, did you hide the presents?
name_questions.answer: Under the stairs, behind the hoover.

name_questions.user: Tell me you packed the marshmallows, {name}.
name_questions.answer: Two bags. I'm not a monster.

name_questions.user: {name}, should the coats go on our bed or in the hall?
name_questions.answer: Bed. The hall's already a mess.

name_questions.user: {name}, is this the drill bit for tiles or for wood?
name_questions.answer: Tiles. The wood ones are in the yellow case.

name_questions.user: {name}, is it my turn to keep the fire going?
name_questions.answer: Yes, and don't let it die like last night.

name_questions.user: {name}, did the shelf brackets come with screws or do we need our own?
name_questions.answer: There's a little bag taped underneath.

name_questions.user: {name}, how much petrol have we got left?
name_questions.answer: Quarter of a tank. We should stop soon.

name_questions.user: {name}, did you plant the tomatoes too close to the fence again?
name_questions.answer: They like the warmth, leave them alone.

name_questions.user: Hey {name}, is the gas canister empty or just cold?
name_questions.answer: Empty. I told you this morning.

name_questions.user: I think we missed the turn. {name}, what did the sign say?
name_questions.answer: Something about a bypass, I wasn't looking.

name_questions.user: Do you know if they're allowed screens before bed, {name}?
name_questions.answer: One episode, then lights out.

name_questions.user: {name}, did the toaster end up in the van or the car?
name_questions.answer: The car, under my coat.

name_questions.user: I'm heading to the shed. {name}, do you need anything from there?
name_questions.answer: The good secateurs, please.

name_questions.user: Are the strawberries ready to pick yet, {name}?
name_questions.answer: A few. The birds got the rest.

name_questions.user: {name}, can you check if the next services has a proper toilet?
name_questions.answer: Twelve miles. Can you last?

name_questions.user: {name}, are those slugs or just wet leaves on the lettuce?
name_questions.answer: Slugs. Loads of them.

name_questions.user: {name}, did you pack the tent pegs or did I?
name_questions.answer: Neither of us, apparently.

name_questions.user: Is the water from that stream safe to drink, {name}?
name_questions.answer: Not without boiling it first.

name_questions.user: {name}, did you hear something moving outside the tent?
name_questions.answer: It's a hedgehog. Go to sleep.

name_questions.user: They want pancakes now. {name}, do we have any eggs left?
name_questions.answer: Two. Make them count.
